finding: 399 field, 1,598 plot and 736 soil records
decision: Use as baseline counts for every later check
rationale: Any later change in counts must be explained

finding: 0 duplicate field keys, 0 duplicate plot IDs, 0 duplicate rows
decision: Field grain = block_id + season; plot grain = plot_id
rationale: Keys confirmed unique

check_performed: Every plot has a field record
finding: 5 plots in 2 field-season units have no field record (block_id absent from Field_Level)
decision: Keep the plots; flag has_field_match = False
rationale: Without mega-environment they cannot enter the adjusted models; deleting them would hide the issue

check_performed: Every soil record matches a plot
finding: 0 soil records without a matching plot
decision: No action needed
rationale: Soil table can be joined one-to-one

check_performed: Four plots / four treatments per field-season unit
finding: 396/401 (98.8%) units complete; 5 units have 2-3 treatments (14 plots)
decision: Keep observed plots; flag_incomplete_unit; never create placeholder plots
rationale: The mixed model uses within-field contrasts and handles unbalanced units

finding: Four treatments, 397-401 plots each
decision: No action
rationale: Balanced enough for pooled comparisons

variables: planting_date, germ_count_date, urea_V6_date, urea_V10_date, silking_date, R3_date, harvest_date
finding: 7 date columns stored as text; all non-missing values parse as m/d/Y
decision: Add *_parsed datetime columns; keep original text
rationale: Traceability to the source values

check_performed: Growth-stage dates in a plausible order
finding: 3 violations (R3 before silking: 3)
decision: Keep and flag; exclude flagged plots from date-based variables only
rationale: Single-plot errors in otherwise consistent fields point to entry errors, but the true date is unknown

finding: 9 plots have no silking date
decision: Leave missing; affects days-to-silking and rainfall window only
rationale: No reliable way to infer a growth-stage date

finding: 6 plots have no R3 date
decision: Leave missing; affects days-to-silking and rainfall window only
rationale: No reliable way to infer a growth-stage date

check_performed: V10 date present when a V10 dose is recorded
finding: 115/401 (28.7%) V6+V10 plots lack a V10 date but have a quantity (22A: 115)
decision: Keep missing dates; do not infer dates from quantities
rationale: Season-concentrated pattern suggests a recording gap, not a missed application; the 82% overall missingness is mostly structural (no V10 dose in 3 of 4 treatments)

finding: 162 plots differ from the calculated total (range -1 to +1 kg/ha)
decision: Keep source total; add urea_total_calc and urea_total_diff
rationale: Differences of 1 kg/ha are consistent with rounding and do not change treatment identity

finding: 1 plot(s) at 50.1 t/ha (next highest 10.9); likely a misplaced decimal point
decision: Keep in the main analysis; report results with and without it
rationale: Removing it changes the V6+V10 estimate noticeably but not the recommendation; the true value cannot be confirmed without the field team

finding: 3 fields recorded at 0.26, 0.26, 0 m; Rwanda's lowest point is about 950 m (probable GPS default)
decision: Set alt_clean to missing for these fields; keep original alt
rationale: A 0 m altitude would distort any model that uses elevation

finding: 'Maize' and 'maize' both used (1089 plots capitalised)
decision: Lower-case all crop labels
rationale: Avoids false categories in grouping

finding: 1 treatment code(s) with two wordings (2 plots)
decision: Add treat_details_std (most common wording); analysis uses urea_rate_timing
rationale: Same agronomic treatment; doses confirm it

finding: Missingness depends on season, not on the field: slope_pos 0%-100%; rockness 0%-100%; soil_depth 0%-100%; trialfield_home_min 7%-100%
decision: No imputation in the treatment model; median/most-frequent imputation inside CV folds for prediction only
rationale: Variables were not collected in some seasons, so values are missing by design

finding: 28.8% missing overall; 21A 0%, 22A 60%, 22B 0%
decision: Keep blanks; not used as a predictor
rationale: Concentrated in one season; meaning of blanks unknown

check_performed: Share of plots with a soil record
decision: Keep all plots; has_soil_record flag; pH used only in soil-specific checks
rationale: Coverage differs by season, so the soil subset is not representative of the trial

finding: tot_N, org_C, sand are 100% empty
decision: Fill from SoilGrids at field coordinates (scripts/fetch_soilgrids.py) as sg_* columns
rationale: Brief asks for open-source soil data; measured and modelled values are kept separate

finding: 2 soil records have no pH
decision: Leave missing
rationale: has_soil_record separates 'no soil record' from 'record without pH'

finding: No weather data supplied
decision: Add CHIRPS rainfall from planting to silking (scripts/fetch_chirps_rainfall.py)
rationale: Rainfall is a likely yield driver and the brief asks for it
